How it works

From Your Idea
to Your Perfect Fit.

A considered process.
A garment that feels like you.

  1. 01

    Share your design

    Send an inspiration photograph or describe the outfit you have in mind.

  2. 02

    Discuss the details

    We discuss style, fabric options, estimated price and your event deadline.

  3. 03

    Choose fabric. Get measured.

    Visit to see and feel fabric samples, confirm your selection and take measurements.

  4. 04

    Fitting & delivery

    We prepare your outfit, arrange a fitting and discuss collection or delivery.

All our services

Tailoring Services
for Every Occasion.

01

Custom Tailoring

Personal tailoring for men and women, from suits and executive outfits to formalwear shaped around your preferences.

02

Wedding & Civil Wedding Tailoring

A personal tailoring conversation for your ceremony, civil wedding or wedding celebrations.

03

Graduation Tailoring

Made-to-order outfit enquiries for a milestone worth remembering.

04

Mobile Fitting

A measurement or fitting appointment at your location in Kigali, arranged directly with the Mr Sewing team.

05

Premium Garment Care

A dedicated care conversation for your garments. Confirm available services, suitability and conditions with Mr Sewing.

06

Alterations & Refinements

Garment adjustments assessed around the fit and changes you need.

07

Express Tailoring

Discuss an urgent tailoring request and confirm whether the team can meet your deadline.
